market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $70 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$96-100, in a strong uptrend driven by Hormuz closure. To settle at $70 by end June requires a ~30% collapse, which would need an immediate, decisive de-escalation plus oversupply. Goldman sees $83 average Q4. Reaching $70 settlement within 2 months given current geopolitics is highly improbable.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden end to Iran conflict combined with surprise OPEC supply increase
